name: Two-Dimensional Partial-Cube Structure Equivalence
statement: The VC-bound, forbidden-cube, virtual-hyperplane, expansion, 2d-amalgam, and rank-preserving ample-completion descriptions define the same class.
proof: The cube-minor theorem identifies VC dimension at most two with exclusion of $Q_3$. Hyperplane recursion lowers the bound by one and represents the resulting hyperplanes by virtual isometric trees. The structural theorem then constructs exactly these graphs by controlled expansions or 2d-amalgams and supplies an ample completion without increasing VC dimension.
